title: Visual recognition
reading: A single-figure slide contrasting four core visual recognition tasks, all illustrated on the same photograph of a dog herding three sheep in a field. The four panels are labelled Image Recognition, Semantic Segmentation, Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

visuals.description: Two-by-two grid of the same sheep-and-dog photo annotated four ways: top-left shows class probabilities (P 0.6 sheep, P 0.3 dog, P 0.1 cat, P 0.0 horse); top-right colours all sheep pixels one blue and the dog red; bottom-left draws coloured bounding boxes around the dog and each sheep; bottom-right gives each sheep a distinct colour mask plus a red dog mask.
visuals.assertion: The tasks differ in output granularity: whole-image labels, per-pixel class labels, per-object boxes, and per-pixel labels separated per object instance.

concepts.name: Image recognition (classification)
concepts.why_it_matters: Baseline task producing a class distribution for the whole image.

concepts.name: Semantic segmentation
concepts.why_it_matters: Labels every pixel by class but merges instances of the same class.

concepts.name: Object detection
concepts.why_it_matters: Localises individual objects with bounding boxes.

concepts.name: Instance segmentation
concepts.why_it_matters: Combines pixel-level masks with instance separation.
